Class FightView

java.lang.Object
views.View<FightController>
views.FightView
public class FightView extends View<FightController>
View for the fight screen.

Displays the battle UI: Bugémon sprites, HP bars, combat messages, action/attack panels, and the player's team grid. Handles mouse hover and click popups on team sprites. All visual updates are triggered by FightController.

    • displayTeam

      public void displayTeam(List<BugemonDTO> team)
      Populates the player's or enemy's team grid with sprites for each Bugémon in the given list. If the Bugémon belongs to the player, each sprite shows an HP popup on hover and a stats popup on click.
      Parameters:
      team - the list of Bugémon DTOs to display
